summary: Banco Santander filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.5 billion issuance of 7.250% non-cumulative contingent convertible perpetual preferred Tier 1 securities (AT1 CoCos). The notes are perpetual, callable after 2035, and mandatorily convertible into common shares upon a trigger event. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration statement to raise regulatory capital, not a special situation. No special situation applies.
